assumptions: The 'C' shape is formed by two horizontal green blocks and one vertical red block.
The instruction 'one green brick with a short side facing you' implies the green block has axis=x (dimensions 4x1x2).
The instruction 'a red column brick on its back two rows' means the red block's z-extent aligns with the bottom green block's z-extent.
The instruction 'vertically aligned with the bottom green brick' means the top green block's footprint is directly above the bottom green block's footprint.
The instruction 'on the right side of the 2x2 grid' means the vertical red block is placed in the right column (x=[2,4]), and the horizontal green blocks span the full x-width of the grid (x=[0,4]).
The C shape is centered in the z-dimension of the grid (z=[1,3]).
